title: Inner product and relative Hamming distance
statement: Let $f,g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be Boolean functions. Their uniform inner product equals $1$ minus twice their relative Hamming distance, where that distance is the fraction of inputs on which $f$ and $g$ differ.
